question: Holding robot task, frozen checkpoint, exact reset seed, ACK-uncertainty handling, controller observations and neutral-probe schedule fixed, how do four genuinely dispatched t2/t3 physical Applied/Held outcomes change task success, public history identification, and paid private state reads?
required_shards: 2 tasks * 2 chunks * 4 truth patterns = 16; never drop any and do not regard 128 condition cells as 128 independent seed clusters
registered_exclusions: No outcome-based exclusions, no dropping early refusals, false positives, task failures or missing step3/step4; where fault not reached report intact ITT denominator and exposure.
policy_training: No retraining; exact externally released frozen PPO checkpoints and pinned revision as parent study
physical_execution: Two unknown-ACK native 6DOF controller actions at zero-based steps 2,3, independently applied or replaced with a physically dispatched zero-hold command; oracle accesses audit-only
neutral_probe: One extra known-delivered zero arm-command neutral hold at zero-based step4 for faulted arms that reach step4; every failed early-stop remains a negative result. Public method uses two publicly achieved EE XYZ samples.
outcome_primary: Official ManiSkill task success, paired method discordances and private target reads, reported by seed, task, physical truth and exposure ITT
outcome_secondary: Observed public complete-history selection and wrong-confident selection, public XYZ sensing costs, protected initial physical observation equivalence, pre-fault negative outcomes and refusal reasons
statistical_design: Condition is fully crossed within each task/seed. Compare methods paired within a seed-condition, cluster 4 conditions by source seed. Exact paired discordant analysis per truth/task when possible; bootstrap/permutation CI uses seed clusters, not 128 independent cells. Any superiority or noninferiority needs predeclared threshold and power; this protocol contains no such claim.
honesty_gates: Original 64 truth cases were each on different initial seeds. This new study is prospective, not reinterpretation of those logs.

Same initial observation hash/allowed tolerance must be verified for each arm within condition, and initial source observation hash identical for the four conditions of a source seed; hash mismatch fails experiment.
No state read in classification; audit-only private getter is never decision input
Equal neutral probe arm action for all main competitors that reach t4; early refuses must remain visible and cannot be advertised as probe-exposed
Cannot label this ActionShift/DualABI baseline; actual matched-budget active comparator remains a separate work item
No hardware, network transport, end-to-end VLA or safety guarantee and no third-party replication claims
Do not publish task-success outcomes unless 16/16 original source and all-population independent audit jobs complete
